title: Structured Release Arbitration for Strategic Accounts (revenue-weighted incubation)
creator: Ayesha Khanna
description:
Problem: Strategic (top-tier) accounts frequently submit feature requests or escalations that span multiple cycles. Engineering capacity and roadmap lanes are constrained, and we lack a short, auditable arbitration process that balances revenue impact, product strategy, and technical risk. This ticket defines an operational release-arbitration process (MVP) to decide which strategic-customer asks enter a guarded incubation lane with explicit commit runways and SLAs.

Goal: Create a repeatable, time-boxed 'Priority Arbitration Council' (PAC) flow: intake -> scoring -> arbitration -> runway assignment -> release gating. Ensure decisions are auditable, incorporate revenue-weighted scoring, and provide predictable communication to customers (commit/no-commit + fallback). Deliverables: scoring formula, PAC charter, intake form template, dashboard for tracking ticket runway, and a small pilot with 3 accounts in a single cycle.

Scope (MVP):
- Apply only to accounts meeting the "strategic" threshold (>= $500k ARR or executive sponsorship).
- A lightweight scoring model combining ARR-weight, impact severity, implementation complexity estimate, and signal velocity (support tickets + product usage anomaly).
- PAC meeting cadence: weekly 30-min slot during roadmap cycle; decisions have TTL (2 cycles) unless escalated.
- Runway categories: Explore (no commit), Incubate (time-boxed prototype, 2-4 sprints), Commit (targeted release window, included in roadmap).
- Customer comms playbook for each decision type.

Out-of-scope: full enterprise SLA contracts and Dedicated/Private procurement flows (handled by Sales/Legal).
acceptance_criteria: Scoring rubric documented and reviewed by Eng/Revenue/CS
PAC charter + decision TTL published in Confluence
Intake form live (Confluence + CS Zendesk template) and auto-tags tickets
Pilot: at least 3 strategic asks processed through PAC with outcomes logged
Dashboard showing runway state for each strategic ask (Explore/Incubate/Commit)
decisions: Use revenue-weighted scoring where ARR contribution multiplies base priority to avoid one-off noise
PAC membership: PM lead (chair), 1 Eng lead, 1 Solutions Eng, 1 CS lead, 1 Sales AE (rotating)
Decision TTL set to 2 cycles for Incubate outcomes; Commit outcomes enter standard release planning
Automate basic intake tagging via Zendesk macro and Confluence intake link to reduce manual triage
